histogram.name: VoiceTyping.FirstRunExitStatus
histogram.summary: Records how the Dictation First Run Experience (FRE) onboarding dialog was exited (Completed, Cancelled, or Other). Recorded whenever the FRE dialog is closed.

histogram.name: VoiceTyping.IsEnabledOnProfileInit
histogram.summary: Records whether Dictation is overall enabled (feature and policies enabled) when DictationKeyedService is initialized for a profile.

histogram.name: VoiceTyping.SessionStartSource
histogram.summary: Records the entry point / trigger source whenever a new Dictation session is started.

histogram.name: VoiceTyping.StreamStartTrigger
histogram.summary: Records the trigger source whenever a new Dictation stream is started.
